invariant: Each accepted life event contributes a tile bounded by posC minus LIVE_DELTA_SIZE when its resulting level is positive, and posC plus level times LIVE_DELTA_SIZE. GroupingTile encloses these bounds with MARGINX. A closing event uses its resulting level, not the preceding open level.
causal_divergence: Rust records activation right bounds only for shorthand message activation and omits the left tile bound, so reversed declaration order with a right note leaves a group five units too far right in unshifted coordinates. Explicit activation events are also missing from tile bounds.
planned_change: Fold accepted lifecycle variations in event order to produce each life event tile bounds, include them in group min/max, and preserve the one-time PlayingSpace normalization.
perturbation_axes: explicit versus message-attached activation and closing nested levels
declaration order, right/left/over notes and group nesting
acceptance: Maker candidate only; requires independent checking.
